patches.value: For every M0>=1,a>=0,0<tau<=1 and smooth real mean-zero f,w with ||w||_(H^gamma)<=M0 and ||f-w||_2<=1, set q=tau^gamma+||f-w||_2, take Interp_(a,tau;f), and define rho(t)=-integral_a^t B_s(Y,z)ds-(1/2)integral_a^t B_s(Y,Y)ds-((t-a)/tau)W. Then Vst'=(1/2)B_t(Vst,Vst)+rho', rho'=-B_t(Y,z)-(1/2)B_t(Y,Y)-W/tau, sup||rho||_2<=C_(gamma,M0)*tau*q and ||rho'||_(L^infinity H^(-pstar))<=C_(gamma,M0)*q.

There exist delta0 in (0,1] and K0>0 depending only on T,gamma,R such that for every 0<tau<=delta0/2, every smooth exact twisted v with v'=(1/2)B_t(v,v), sup||v||_(H^gamma)<=M0 and corresponding continuous numerical interpolation V, and every interval I=[a,b] starting at a grid point with b-a<=delta0 and sup_I||v-V||_2<=1, one has sup_I||v-V||_2<=2||v(a)-V(a)||_2+K0*delta0*tau^gamma.
